title: Rule out one mixed affine helper for the QQ16 interface
body:
## Summary

This adds an all-mixer obstruction for one additional eight-coordinate affine helper at the fixed QQ16 `F0/B1` cut. For every rational 8x8 `M`, the response `H + B0 X_U + M B2 X_U + c` leaves at least `32|G|/7` dimensions in `B2(ker[B0+M B2;B1])`. The inherited selected-value witness then gives identical observations for a nonzero selected input and zero input.

The screen grants source access, query arithmetic, helper storage/hosting, update, inverse, restoration, frame/address conversions, local and recursive calls, and precision free. Injectivity still fails, so this interface has no cost or moment gain. No new `kappa`, native implementation, or supplier is claimed.

## Scope and predecessors

- Exact base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`.
- Priority revision 4; selected record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- PR #2104, head `4bdc574da394a39f955e8cf4637075649c43a632`, supplies the exact source-bound three-query rank lemma. The pinned `PROOF.md` SHA-256 is `9c2ad4600d65dd3354db4bae5ac78d13fedf2da6e500224fafaeed596846c887`. Its verifier was downloaded at that head and passed locally against this base on Python 3.14.7. At the last successful hosted status check, 19:52Z, the PR was open and checks were pending. A subsequent status refresh was blocked by the GitHub API rate limit, so the current hosted status is unverified.
- PR #2079 covers a B2-only added observation; PR #2093 covers a qualitative all-nonzero-chart witness; PR #2086 changes the A logger. The 252 first-pair catalogue posted in Discussion #2074 leaves affine helper state outside its scope. This package handles the one mixed `B0+M B2` helper for all rational `M`.
- Original QQ16 maps and selected witness are attributed to the PR #1969 lineage. The exact base source, selected witness, and catalogue pins are in `SOURCES.json`.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/qq16-affine-helper-mix-seed98c45/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-affine-helper-mix-seed98c45 --check-only
```

Observed locally on Python 3.14.7:

- `PASS_QQ16_AFFINE_HELPER_MIX cases=4 positives=4 controls=3 no_new_kappa`
- `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`
- `git diff --cached --check` passed.

Python 3.12 registered replay was not run locally; the direct verifier and package metadata/pin check passed. The direct verifier exercises exact rational row-space recovery, nonzero residual kernels, affine offset/dirty-state cancellation, trace arithmetic, and three mutation controls. It does not recreate the predecessor's route proof or replay the inherited full native trajectory.

## Overlap and attribution

The final `find_overlap.py --refresh` covered 378 open PRs with complete pagination. The Discussion refresh was rate-limited and fell back to the complete cache from 19:47Z (786 records). The live recent Discussion query at 19:58Z found no other current QQ16 helper claim; the relevant existing scopes are identified above. This search is not a novelty certificate.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. The exact proof, bounded scope, and remaining obligations are in `research/qq16-affine-helper-mix-seed98c45/`.
